card.name: First character of table and list entries
card.fires_on: A single character or short word that begins a new entry in a table, list or heading, such as a leading digit, a lone letter A or B, or the word first. It appears in dose tables, label diagrams and section numbers.

modes.label: Digits in tables
modes.description: A digit inside a row of numbers in a dosing or weight table, often the first or second digit of a value.

modes.label: Lone letters starting an item
modes.description: A single capital letter A or B that labels a part or begins a sentence after a heading.
